scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build:apps
scripts.build:packages: npm run build --workspace=@sports-ai/shared && npm run build --workspace=@sports-ai/prompts
scripts.build:apps: npm run build --workspace=@sports-ai/api && npm run build --workspace=@sports-ai/web
scripts.clean: rm -rf node_modules apps/*/node_modules packages/*/node_modules apps/*/.next packages/*/dist apps/*/dist
